title: Drag and Drop List
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Build a React functional component called `DragDropList` that takes a prop `items` (array of `{ id: string, text: string }`) and `onReorder` (function). Render each item as a draggable list item. Users can drag items to reorder them. During drag, show a visual drop indicator by adding class `drop-target` to the drop position. After dropping, call `onReorder` with the new items array. Each item should have `data-testid="item-{id}"` and `draggable="true"`.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Functional component with `useState`
- Default export
- Props: `items` and `onReorder`
- HTML5 drag and drop API
- Visual drop indicator with class `drop-target`
- `data-testid="item-{id}"` on each item
- `draggable="true"` on each item
- Call `onReorder` with reordered array after drop

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
constraints: Call `onReorder` with reordered array after drop
